THE ONLY FILE YOU NEED TO EDIT. Fill in the values between the quotes.
Anything left as "" or [] hides itself — an empty family list removes the Family section and its menu link.
weddingDate must be ISO: "2026-12-12". weddingTime is free text: "After Maghrib" or "7:00 PM onwards" (a clock time in it feeds the countdown).
googleMapsUrl: paste the Share link from Google Maps. Leave it "" and the map finds the venue from its name and address.
rsvp.type is one of: whatsapp | form | url | none. For whatsapp, value is the number with country code and no +, e.g. "919876543210".
Photos go in public/images/ and are referenced as "/images/name.jpg". Music goes in public/music/.
Any image you leave out is replaced by generated gold geometry, so a half-filled file still looks finished.
colors: primary is the deep tone, secondary the soft background, accent the gold. Change these three and the whole site follows.

story.title: How we met
story.body: Introduced by family over chai that went cold twice, and a conversation that simply never ended.

story.title: The promise
story.body: A quiet yes in front of both families, and a phone call to every relative before the evening was out.

timeline.title: Nikah
timeline.description: The nikah nama is signed, the qubool hai is said, and dua is made for the years ahead.

timeline.title: Walima
timeline.description: Dinner, duas and the first evening hosted together as husband and wife.

family.name: Mr. & Mrs. Rehman

family.note: Forty years married, and still the first to reach the dinner table.

family.name: Adnan
family.note: In charge of the baraat, and taking it very seriously.

venueNote: Both the nikah and the walima are at the same venue. Valet parking at Gate 2; please arrive twenty minutes before the nikah.

rsvp.label: RSVP
rsvp.message: Assalamu alaikum! We would love to attend Aaliya & Faiz's nikah.
rsvp.note: Kindly let us know by the date above so we can plan the seating.

blessing.text: And among His signs is that He created for you mates from among yourselves, that you may dwell in tranquillity with them, and He has put love and mercy between your hearts.

footerNote: Your duas and your presence are the greatest blessings we could ask for. Insha'Allah, we will see you there.
